channel.title: CapMeter — Claude & Codex limit changes
channel.description: Dated, source-linked records of changes to Claude and Codex usage limits, plans and pricing.

item.title: Claude Fable 5.2 launch: a free Fable week for Pro and up to three Fable resets for Max and Ultra
item.description: From November 9 to 16, 2026, Pro plans can spend up to 50% of their weekly limit on Fable models. Max and Ultra get one to three Fable limit resets, valid until March 8, 2027.

item.title: Plus, Pro and Business: Codex and ChatGPT move to one token budget in December
item.description: OpenAI plans to count Codex and ChatGPT usage on Plus, Pro and Business against a single token-based budget from December. Instant chat is excluded; no exact date or size yet.

item.title: Codex on ChatGPT Pro currently has no five-hour limit
item.description: OpenAI's Codex pricing documentation says Pro plans currently have no five-hour limit. Plus and Standard Business still have one, and weekly limits may apply.

item.title: Ultra replaces Max 20x: same $200, and only weekly caps on verified accounts
item.description: Anthropic moved Max 20x subscribers to a plan called Ultra at $200 a month. Verified Ultra accounts have weekly caps only (10× Pro, plus a Fable cap) and no five-hour window.

item.title: Claude Code's summer boost ended, but half of it stayed for good
item.description: The +50% Claude Code weekly boost ran May 13 – September 13, 2026. From September 14 Anthropic kept +25% over the pre-May level on Pro, Max, Ultra, Team and seat-based Enterprise.

item.title: Claude limit resets: one-time refills for your five-hour or weekly limit
item.description: Eligible Claude plans occasionally get a one-time limit reset that refills the five-hour limit, the weekly limit or weekly Fable usage, used from Settings → Usage.

item.title: October 7, 2026: some Claude organizations were wrongly paused at their spend limit
item.description: Anthropic's status page recorded an issue that wrongly paused some organizations for reaching their spend limit, refusing requests across the API, Claude.ai and Claude Code.
